name: Hasupha
title: Temple Servant Who Returned from Exile
summary: Hasupha was the ancestor of a family of Nethinim (temple servants) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel. His descendants are mentioned in the lists of those who returned to rebuild the temple and restore worship in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Temple Servants in Ezra's List
keyEvents.description: Hasupha's descendants are mentioned among the Nethinim (temple servants) who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Temple Servants in Nehemiah's List
keyEvents.description: Hasupha's family is also mentioned in Nehemiah's parallel list of those who returned from exile, confirming the family's role as temple servants.

keyEvents.title: The Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Hasupha was part of the large group that returned to Judah under Zerubbabel's leadership, following King Cyrus's decree allowing the Jews to return.

keyEvents.title: Service of the Nethinim in the Temple
keyEvents.description: As Nethinim, the descendants of Hashubah were assigned duties in temple service and settled near the temple to carry out their responsibilities.
